description: Writes a short text and email asking a customer for a deposit once they say yes, plus a confirmation for when it's paid. The owner sets the amount and the terms.

defaultPrompt: Rob accepted my $2,580 fence estimate. I want 20% down to hold the 14th. Write the deposit request.
interface.longDescription: Deposit Requester writes the message you need after a customer says yes: a short text and a matching email asking for the deposit, a confirmation to send once it's paid, and, if you want one, a short deposit policy for your booking page. You set the amount and the terms. It works out percentages exactly, never invents a refund or cancellation rule, and never makes legal claims. It never sends anything for you. You check it and send it yourself.
interface.shortDescription: Ask for the deposit without the awkward feeling

name: deposit-requester
